The '''Antipose Arena''' was located on a [[Antipose|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The retired space pirate [[Raskar]] ran a gladiatorial contest there with the [[Power gem]] as the prize for the eventual winner.
